episodes.title: Hamoodi
episodes.summary: Living in Texas, Mo loses his job at a mobile store and looks for a new gig as his Palestinian family waits on their pending asylum request.

episodes.title: Yamo
episodes.summary: Scarred after a tough incident, Mo refuses to slow down and attends a wake with Maria. Legal tensions boil to the surface, complicating a family matter.

episodes.title: Remorse
episodes.summary: Plagued by nightmares and stress, a torn Mo turns to instant relief. At a meeting with his new immigration lawyer, an unsettling truth is revealed.

episodes.title: Moola
episodes.summary: Mo finds stability in a new gig until a merch deal goes south. Hoping to expand the shop, Maria meets with an investor but the pitch doesen`t go to plan.

episodes.title: Tombstone
episodes.summary: Mo visits an estranged family member to obtain a document for the Najjars` asylum case. When Sameer gets into trouble, the family unites to help.

episodes.title: Holy Matrimony
episodes.summary: Hamid`s big day is off to a rocky start when his groomsmen end up on a dangerous mission. At the house, Maria has an uncomfortable exchange with Yusra.

episodes.title: Testimony
episodes.summary: As their asylum hearing date approaches, Lizzie preps the Najjars and Yusra gets candid. Anxious and depleted, Mo struggles to cope with his new reality.

episodes.title: Vamos
episodes.summary: Yusra and Sameer unveil their business idea to Mo and invite him on board. Mo later cuts a deal with Buddy that leads him to uncharted territory.

episodes.title: Oso Palestino (the Palestinian Bear)
episodes.summary: Mo works odd jobs while stranded in Mexico City. As his family's asylum hearing back in Houston approaches, his options to return dwindle.

episodes.title: Gone Fishing
episodes.summary: Yusra and Sameer receive long-awaited good news. Following an ordeal at the border, Mo tries to reconnect with loved ones, but finds himself left behind.

episodes.title: Yes Chef, No Chef
episodes.summary: Reeling from heartbreak, Mo returns to his grind and gets unsolicited advice. Old flames burn and new sparks fly at Nick and Toya's housewarming.

episodes.title: Hit the Road Jack
episodes.summary: Mo grapples with his immigration status and his feelings about Maria as he and Sameer clash over managing the family business.

episodes.title: Thank You Jesus
episodes.summary: Craving privacy and independence, Mo moves in with Hameed and Dallas — who have other plans for him. Yusra and Nadia clash over Sameer's wellbeing.

episodes.title: Bandido De Tacos
episodes.summary: Mo is back at square one after clearing up a misunderstanding. Buddy's news hits hard, but the Najjars roll with the punches to salvage their business.

episodes.title: Field of Dreams
episodes.summary: A remorseful Mo sets out to make amends after a costly altercation. An unexpected guest shows up to the Najjars' Thanksgiving dinner.

episodes.title: A Call From God
episodes.summary: Almost a year later, the Najjars embark on a long-awaited visit to their homeland. At point blank, Mo's recurring dream comes to fruition.
